pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Schliemann Defense, Möhring Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 routed the rook ...Ra7-d7 onto its own queen; overview said one pawn down (two) and claimed a lead in development Black does not have (reviewer rejected; fixed and accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Schliemann, 4.d3 fxe4
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Rf6-g6 with no rook able to reach f6 and called the f-file open. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Schliemann, 4.Nc3 fxe4 5.Nxe4 d5 6.Nxe5
pages.notes: Plan 3 targeted g7 and an f7-pawn that has gone; overview made concrete (7.Nxc6 hits the queen). British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Schliemann, 4.Nc3 fxe4 5.Nxe4 d5 6.Nxe5
pages.notes: Plan 4 castled queenside with the c8-bishop at home; plan 3 had f3 blunting the queen. Rewritten around 9.f4 (reviewer rejected the first wording, which said f4 cuts the g5-g2 line; fixed and accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Schliemann, 4.Nc3 fxe4 5.Nxe4 Nf6 6.Nxf6+
pages.notes: Plan 1 castled queenside with the c1-bishop at home and a g4-h4 storm; plan 4 relied on O-O-O. Rewritten around Bxc6 and Nxe5 (reviewer rejected a claimed lead in development; fixed and accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Schliemann, 4.Nc3 fxe4 5.Nxe4 Nf6 6.Nxf6+
pages.notes: Plan 3 castled White queenside with the c1-bishop at home. Rewritten; reviewer rejected recommending ...bxc6 over the standard ...dxc6, fixed and accepted. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Schliemann, 4.d3
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight via d2 or g1-e2. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Schliemann, 4.Nc3 fxe4 5.Nxe4 Nf6 6.Nxf6+
pages.notes: Overview called 6...gxf6 the main move (6...Qxf6 is usual); plan 1 played Be3 through the d2-pawn and castled queenside. Rewritten. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Classical Defense, Boden Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 took on d4 before White has a d-pawn there; plans 3-4 wrote castling with zeros and Nbd2 through the d2-pawn. Rewritten (reviewer rejected the c5-bishop "holding e5"; fixed and accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Classical Defense, Zaitsev Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed c3-d4 onto the d4-knight and called the b-file open; rewritten around c3 hitting both b4 and d4. British spelling.
